summary: Without prior public consultation, Metrolinx announced the proposed location of the Ontario Line Maintenance and Storage Facility in Thorncliffe Park through a blog post on April 8, 2021. The subsequent community meeting did not provide an opportunity for open, transparent dialogue. Comments and questions were limited to a 160 character chat box. Translation services were not provided and promotional materials were printed only in English. Despite these barriers, more than 500 community members were in attendance and 747 questions and comments were submitted through the chat box. The proposed Maintenance and Storage Facility would directly impact what many consider to be the cultural centre of the Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood, including the local halal grocer, place of worship, and several small businesses and community services. The proposed site will be 175,000 square metres, equal to approximately 24 soccer fields. Thorncliffe Park is a geographically small neighbourhood that is home to a large and diverse community. Their voices need to be heard as part of this process. The Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood deserves access to rapid transit, but not at the expense of important cultural institutions, community services, and local businesses. This Motion is urgent because it relates to Metrolinx's recently-announced Ontario Line Maintenance and Storage Facility location and…
decided: City Council on May 5 and 6, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council express significant concerns about the impacts the proposed Maintenance and Storage Facility site would have on the Thorncliffe Park neighbourhood. 2. City Council direct the City Manager to convey to Metrolinx the following requests related to the proposed Ontario Line Maintenance and Storage Facility site: a. that Metrolinx engage the community in a transparent public consultation process that is inclusive of all Thorncliffe Park residents, providing translation services and tailored outreach as needed; and b. that Metrolinx consider alternative site options.
